catchphrase.match: Match each famous name to its catchphrase.

rows.label: Forrest Gump
rows.catchphrase: Life is like a box of chocolates.
rows.hook: follows a kind-hearted Alabama man who ends up present at major moments of modern American history

rows.label: Rodney Dangerfield
rows.hook: is a comedian famous for self-deprecating one-liners and endless complaints about his hard luck

rows.label: Casey Kasem
rows.catchphrase: Keep your feet on the ground and keep reaching for the stars.

rows.label: Pee-wee Herman
rows.catchphrase: I know you are, but what am I?
rows.description: comic fictional character played by Paul Reubens
rows.hook: is a childlike comic persona who grew from a stage act into a quirky kids' TV playhouse show

rows.label: Gollum
rows.hook: is a wretched creature, once a river-dwelling hobbit, twisted by obsession with a magic ring

rows.label: Daffy Duck
rows.hook: is a screwball black waterfowl from Looney Tunes who is forever a foil to Bugs Bunny

rows.label: Riddler
rows.description: fictional character, a comic book supervillain who appears in comic books published by DC Comics

rows.label: Elmer Fudd
rows.catchphrase: Be very, very quiet, I'm hunting wabbits.
rows.hook: is a hapless Looney Tunes human who swaps his Rs and Ls for Ws while forever chasing Bugs Bunny

rows.label: Jimmy Durante
rows.catchphrase: Good night, Mrs. Calabash, wherever you are.

rows.label: Steve Urkel
rows.description: fictional character on the sitcom Family Matters
rows.hook: is a bothersome neighbor who was meant for one episode but became his sitcom's most popular character

rows.label: Shaggy Rogers
rows.hook: is an amateur detective whose best friend is a dog, in a long-running mystery cartoon franchise

rows.label: Woody (Toy Story)
rows.catchphrase: There's a snake in my boot!
rows.description: fictional toy cowboy character from Disney and Pixar's Toy Story franchise
rows.hook: is a pull-string sheriff doll, mostly voiced by Tom Hanks, who is Buzz Lightyear's pal

rows.label: Edna Mode
rows.hook: is an eccentric fashion designer who makes costumes for superheroes

rows.label: Glenn Quagmire
rows.description: fictional character from the animated series Family Guy
rows.hook: is the retro, Rat Pack-style party animal living next door to the Griffins

rows.label: Don Cornelius
rows.catchphrase: We wish you love, peace and soul!

rows.label: Rod Roddy
rows.hook: is an offstage game-show announcer who succeeded Johnny Olson on a famous prices-guessing show

rows.label: Scorpion (Mortal Kombat)
rows.hook: is a yellow-clad ninja who harpoons foes with a rope dart
